We also explore dopamine and social media, overstimulation, digital wellbeing and the effects of short videos on the brain. Why does scrolling often leave us feeling empty? Why are we afraid of boredom? And why do we keep reaching for our phones even when we know we should stop?
But is quitting your phone really the answer? We explore practical ways to build a healthier digital lifestyle—from digital detox and no-device zones to choosing better content and spending more meaningful time with family, friends and the world around us.
